_comment: COPY this file to params/prod.json (gitignored) and fill in the real secret values. The real prod.json carries live secrets forward into `sam deploy` / the IMPORT change-set so they are never re-typed or committed. Non-secret parameters (DB IDs, flags, role ARN, bucket) use the defaults baked into template.yaml / import/import-template.yaml and only need to appear here if you want to override them. Format = `aws cloudformation --parameters file://` (also consumed by scripts/deploy-sam.ps1).
